text: Different places. One photo. Welcome to TwoGether Booth.
Create a booth. Add your name, then turn on your camera. Your microphone starts off.
Copy your private invitation link, and send it to your person.
They open the link, check their camera, and ask to join.
Let them in. Now you're together in your own little booth.
Choose a frame, add your names, and write a caption to make the strip yours.
When you're both ready, tap Ready. Then the host starts the photos.
Follow the countdown, and strike three poses together.
Your photos come together in one shared strip.
Download your photo strip as a PNG, and keep this little memory.
Your person receives the very same strip.
A little closer, wherever you are. Create your booth and make a memory.
